name: 600 front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 133 g for the original Shimano 600 FD-6100 front derailleur with its 1⅛-inch (nominal 28.6 mm) clamp. This is the complete clamp-mounted reference, not a later 600 EX assembly.

technical_document.title: Shimano FD-6100 manufacturer exploded view: model identification, series and replacement parts

sources.title: Shimano FD-6100 manufacturer exploded view: model identification, series and replacement parts
